primary_claim: Applying topological data analysis (Mapper-style graph models) to wide feature sets, including sparse autoencoder features from OpenAI's GPT2-small, produces coherent, interpretable groups of features that act in concert and provide higher-level explanations than individual features alone.
limitations_stated: in the GPT2-small SAE feature model (Figure 5), the explanations produced are syntactic, and not particularly semantic
quote: The graph models increase interpretability of results, in that they help identify meaningful groups of features which act in concert.
